title:
Cold, and icy Rochdale 🧊 ❄️ 

For the adults we support, we have been focusing on keeping them warm and safe by encouraging layered clothing and heating their homes. 🏠 
Ensuring they have sufficient food and have hot drinks and meals to stay hydrated and warm! 🥞🧇 ⏰
